spec.title: Last Successful Run Age
spec.description: Detects a loss of successful processing even when failed runs keep finishing. Based on the retained successful-run timestamp; no value means no success has been recorded. Hourly schedule: warning after 2 hours, critical after 4 hours.

spec.title: Latest Run Result
spec.description: Shows whether the latest reported processing run succeeded or failed. Each fresh process records one run outcome, and Pushgateway replaces the run timer family at cleanup. A success may still leave locked directories pending. Initialization failures or a hard kill before metrics are pushed cannot update this result; check the freshness panels.

spec.title: Last Run Age
spec.description: Detects missing completions, a stuck run, or a missing metrics push. A recent completion with an old successful-run timestamp indicates repeated failures. Hourly schedule: warning after 90 minutes, critical after 150 minutes.

spec.title: Remaining Directories (Last Run)
spec.description: Shows discovered directories left unmarked at the last reported completion, including failures and locked directories. This is a completed-run snapshot, not the current HDFS backlog; directories arriving afterward are not included.

spec.title: Last Run Duration
spec.description: Shows how long the latest processing run took, including directory discovery. One run is recorded per process, so its timer sum is the complete duration. Warns at the hourly schedule interval; excludes shutdown and metrics-push time.

spec.title: Failed Directories (Last Run)
spec.description: Shows whether the latest run stopped on a directory-processing failure. This counter is initialized to zero in every process, so zero is meaningful. Retries are attempts, not unique directories. Failure before directory processing can still produce a failed run with zero failed directories.

spec.title: Run Result History
spec.description: Shows when reported runs changed between success and failure. This is the latest result at each scrape, not a count of runs; multiple pushes between scrapes can be missed. Read alongside run age because an unchanged result does not establish that another run finished.

spec.title: Run Duration History
spec.description: Reveals runs approaching or exceeding the hourly schedule interval. Each point is the latest reported run duration, grouped by outcome. Identical durations across consecutive runs remain flat; this is snapshot history, not a percentile distribution.

spec.title: Remaining Directories History
spec.description: Shows whether reported runs leave increasing amounts of discovered work unfinished. Values update at completion; this is not a continuously refreshed HDFS backlog.

spec.title: Directory Outcomes (Last Run)
spec.description: Separates successful, failed, and skipped directory attempts in each reported run. Skipped attempts can be marked processed without producing cubes. Locked directories remain pending and are not counted as skipped attempts.

spec.title: Average Directory Duration (Last Run)

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (cube_maker_directory_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job"}) / (sum by (outcome) (cube_maker_directory_duration_seconds_count{job="$job"}) > 0) and on (outcome) (sum by (outcome) (cube_maker_directories_processed_total{job="$job"}) > 0)

spec.description: Measures elapsed directory-attempt time, including cube writes and the tracking update. Uses timer sum/count rather than percentile buckets. Outcomes with no attempts in the latest run are hidden so a retained timer from an earlier run is not displayed.

spec.title: Directory Input Bytes (Last Run)
spec.description: Shows the compressed Parquet workload attempted in each reported run, separating failed and skipped work from successful work. Full known input size is counted even on failure, and retries count again. This is not Spark I/O or network throughput.

spec.title: Cube Attempts by Outcome
spec.description: Identifies which cube is failing or receiving fewer attempts while a run is active. Shows completed attempts recorded in the currently scraped process, not cumulative lifetime totals. Idle jobs produce gaps; attempts completed after the final pod scrape can be missed.

spec.title: Average Cube Duration
spec.description: Identifies the slow cube within an active processing run. This is the running average of completed attempts per cube and outcome, including Spark computation, staging, and PostgreSQL merge. Live pod scrapes produce gaps between runs.

spec.title: Rows Upserted by Cube (Selected Range)
spec.description: Compares committed output volume among cubes during the selected dashboard range. Estimates increases from live pod scrapes, handling resets per series before aggregation. Initial/final writes between scrapes can be missed; no samples is not zero output. Counts rows inserted or updated, including retries, not unique rows.

spec.title: Write Attempts by Phase and Outcome
spec.description: Locates failures in Spark JDBC staging versus PostgreSQL merge/cleanup/commit. A staging success followed by an upsert failure points to the merge phase. Shows attempts recorded in the currently scraped process; idle jobs produce gaps.

spec.title: Average Staging Write Duration
spec.description: Identifies slow Spark-to-PostgreSQL JDBC writes independently of the final merge. Shows the running average of completed staging writes per cube and outcome in live pod scrapes; excludes in-progress attempts.

spec.title: Average Upsert Duration
spec.description: Identifies slow PostgreSQL merge, staging cleanup, and commit independently of the JDBC staging write. Shows the running average of completed upserts per cube and outcome in live pod scrapes; excludes in-progress attempts.

spec.title: Cube Maker
spec.description: Hourly cube-maker batch processing: freshness and latest reported run state first, then run history, directories, cubes, and PostgreSQL writes. Metrics Job selects completed-run Pushgateway snapshots; Namespace selects live pod metrics in the last two rows. Cube filters the last two rows only. Live pod metrics have gaps between runs and can miss final activity; reported snapshots update only during cleanup. See panel descriptions for interpretation.
